design_system.name: Sand Design System Library

extraction.method: Figma REST API full-file tree walk (depth-unlimited), descended INTO every component set
extraction.why: search_design_system searches PUBLISHED libraries only, and this library keeps its components on the file’s own pages. The Figma MCP server also refused this file outright (the account holds a View seat with no edit access), so the walk was done through the REST API instead.
limitations: Figma Variables API (/v1/files/:key/variables/local) returned 403: the token lacks the file_variables:read scope and the plan is starter tier. Colour and spacing tokens were therefore read from the library’s own documented Colors and Spacing & Effects pages, which state the hexes, token names and CSS variables explicitly. Consequence: variable IDs are NOT recorded, so downstream a token binding can be checked by NAME but not verified by ID.

The MCP server (get_metadata / get_libraries / use_figma) is unavailable on this account. Read stages can use REST; the phase-2 component pass and phase-3 assembly need the Plugin API through MCP and will be blocked until the account is granted edit access.

colors._model: Ten 10-step ramps (05–90). Semantic text / border / surface / icon / status tokens are built on top of these primitives for Light and Dark mode.

Navy-Blue.usage: Use for primary brand surfaces, headers, and key actions.

Orange.usage: Use for emphasis, highlights, and high-contrast accents.

Purple.usage: Use for secondary emphasis and supporting brand moments.

Lime.usage: Use for bright highlights, success states, and energetic accents.

Peach.usage: Use for warm accents, soft highlights, and subtle emphasis.

Grey.usage: Use for neutral text, subtle icons, borders, and muted UI elements.

Warning.usage: Use for warnings, cautions, and attention-grabbing highlights.

Error.usage: Use for errors, destructive actions, and critical alerts.

Critical.usage: Use for errors, destructive actions, and critical alerts.

Success.usage: Use for success states, confirmations, and positive outcomes.

Info.usage: Use for info states, links, and interactive emphasis.

typography._family: Inter (primary, web + mobile). Barlow / Outfit / Geist appear on documentation frames only, not in product components.

spacing._model: Figma variable collection "Spacing": 12 hidden primitives aliased 1:1 to 12 semantic tokens. Bind the SEMANTIC token, never the primitive, never a raw px.

shadows._model: Primitive shadow styles XS/S/M/L/XL by Y-offset, plus three named elevation effect styles and the Card Glass Effect.

Card Glass Effect.rule: OPT-IN. The library states explicitly: ask the user before applying it to any widget; never apply it by default.

border_radius._model: Shares the 4/6/8/10/12/16/20/24/32 primitive progression with Spacing; 999px for pills.

binding_rules: Bind padding, gap and margin to a semantic Spacing token (space-3xs … space-6xl). Never a raw pixel value.
Never bind a primitive spacing token directly — always go through the semantic layer.
Reuse an existing token or shared style (Spacing, Radius, Color, Typography) before proposing a new one.
Swap Light/Dark overlay and border together as a pair; never mix modes.
The Card Glass Effect is opt-in — ask before applying it to a widget.
